def build(w):
    s=np.sin(w*t); c_=np.cos(w*t)
    T=[np.ones_like(t),t,s,c_]
    Pf=[np.ones_like(P),P,np.sqrt(P),P**2]

import numpy as np
def equation(t, P, params):
